name: BIC-pruned DirectLiNGAM
tagline: Run DirectLiNGAM ordering, then iteratively delete each node's parents whenever doing so lowers the per-node BIC.

key_hyperparams.name: gap margin
key_hyperparams.role: safety multiplier on log-gap pre-pruning threshold

init_recovers: DirectLiNGAM if no edges are pruned
diff_from_baseline: Adds two pruning stages on top of the DirectLiNGAM baseline: a per-node largest-log-gap pre-prune and a multi-pass per-node BIC backward elimination, replacing arbitrary thresholding.

name: Hybrid LiNGAM + LassoLarsIC + t-test pruning
tagline: Combine DirectLiNGAM and pairwise non-Gaussian ordering, then refine each node's parent set with adaptive Lasso BIC and a t-statistic filter.

key_hyperparams.name: refit passes
key_hyperparams.role: iterations of t-test pruning per node

diff_from_baseline: Replaces the single DirectLiNGAM ordering with a multi-source order selector (DirectLiNGAM + pairwise non-Gaussian + rank-blended) and adds adaptive-Lasso BIC + iterative t-statistic + magnitude pruning per node.

name: DirectLiNGAM + per-node BIC pruning
tagline: DirectLiNGAM ordering followed by an OLS refit and a single-pass weakest-coefficient BIC backward elimination per node.

key_hyperparams.name: Δ-BIC threshold
key_hyperparams.role: minimum positive evidence to drop an edge

init_recovers: DirectLiNGAM if no edges drop the BIC by 2
diff_from_baseline: Adds a single per-node OLS refit followed by greedy weakest-coefficient BIC pruning on top of DirectLiNGAM, dropping each parent only if Δ-BIC > 2.
